import pytest
from subject import DefaultEnvelopeChunker, EnvelopeFactory, ModelChunkedEnvelope, ModelChunkMetadata


class TestEnvelope:
    """Minimal envelope implementing ProtocolChunkableEnvelope and EnvelopeFactory for testing."""

    def __init__(self, data: bytes):
        self._data = data

    def to_bytes(self) -> bytes:
        return self._data

    @classmethod
    def from_bytes(cls, data: bytes) -> "TestEnvelope":
        return cls(data)


@pytest.mark.unit
def test_chunk_basic():
    chunker = DefaultEnvelopeChunker()
    envelope = TestEnvelope(b"hello world")
    chunks = chunker.chunk(envelope, max_chunk_size=5)

    assert len(chunks) == 3
    assert all(isinstance(c, ModelChunkedEnvelope) for c in chunks)
    assert chunks[0].chunk_payload == b"hello"
    assert chunks[1].chunk_payload == b" worl"
    assert chunks[2].chunk_payload == b"d"
    # metadata consistency
    for i, c in enumerate(chunks):
        assert c.chunk_metadata.chunk_index == i
        assert c.chunk_metadata.chunk_count == 3
        assert c.chunk_metadata.total_size == 11
        assert c.chunk_metadata.chunk_size == len(c.chunk_payload)
        assert c.chunk_metadata.payload_checksum == chunks[0].chunk_metadata.payload_checksum
        assert c.chunk_metadata.chunk_checksum == c.chunk_metadata.chunk_checksum  # self-consistency


@pytest.mark.unit
def test_chunk_empty_payload():
    chunker = DefaultEnvelopeChunker()
    envelope = TestEnvelope(b"")
    chunks = chunker.chunk(envelope, max_chunk_size=10)

    assert len(chunks) == 1
    assert chunks[0].chunk_payload == b""
    assert chunks[0].chunk_metadata.chunk_size == 0
    assert chunks[0].chunk_metadata.total_size == 0
    assert chunks[0].chunk_metadata.chunk_count == 1


@pytest.mark.unit
def test_chunk_max_chunk_size_larger_than_payload():
    chunker = DefaultEnvelopeChunker()
    envelope = TestEnvelope(b"tiny")
    chunks = chunker.chunk(envelope, max_chunk_size=100)

    assert len(chunks) == 1
    assert chunks[0].chunk_payload == b"tiny"
    assert chunks[0].chunk_metadata.chunk_size == 4


@pytest.mark.unit
def test_chunk_max_chunk_size_equal_to_payload():
    chunker = DefaultEnvelopeChunker()
    envelope = TestEnvelope(b"exact")
    chunks = chunker.chunk(envelope, max_chunk_size=5)

@pytest.mark.unit

@pytest.mark.unit
def test_reassemble_corrupted_chunk_raises():
    chunker = DefaultEnvelopeChunker()
    original = TestEnvelope(b"corrupt me")
    chunks = chunker.chunk(original, max_chunk_size=4)
    # corrupt payload of first chunk
    bad_chunk = ModelChunkedEnvelope(
        envelope_headers={},
        chunk_metadata=chunks[0].chunk_metadata,
        chunk_payload=b"bad!",
    )
    bad_chunks = [bad_chunk] + chunks[1:]

    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="checksum mismatch on chunk 0"):
        chunker.reassemble(bad_chunks, TestEnvelope)


@pytest.mark.unit
def test_reassemble_full_payload_checksum_mismatch_raises():
    chunker = DefaultEnvelopeChunker()
    original = TestEnvelope(b"full payload checksum")
    chunks = chunker.chunk(original, max_chunk_size=6)
    # replace last chunk with same size but different data, keeping its chunk checksum valid
    last = chunks[-1]
    new_payload = b"XXXXXX"  # same length as last.chunk_payload
    # create a chunk with valid chunk checksum but different payload
    from subject import _sha256_hex
    new_metadata = ModelChunkMetadata(
        chunk_series_id=last.chunk_metadata.chunk_series_id,
        chunk_index=last.chunk_metadata.chunk_index,
        chunk_count=last.chunk_metadata.chunk_count,
        chunk_size=len(new_payload),
        total_size=last.chunk_metadata.total_size,
        payload_checksum=last.chunk_metadata.payload_checksum,
        chunk_checksum=_sha256_hex(new_payload),
        reassembly_strategy=last.chunk_metadata.reassembly_strategy,
    )
    bad_last = ModelChunkedEnvelope(
        envelope_headers={},
        chunk_metadata=new_metadata,
        chunk_payload=new_payload,
    )
    bad_chunks = chunks[:-1] + [bad_last]

    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="Full payload checksum mismatch after reassembly"):
        chunker.reassemble(bad_chunks, TestEnvelope)
